topics.topic: Acceptance status, scope, and effective date of R0-19 and R0-20
questions: Were R0-19 and R0-20 separately accepted amendments, or was the whole document accepted or re-accepted on 2026-10-27?
Were R0-19 and R0-20 accepted as amendments to State 0, and what is the effective acceptance date of the whole document?

quotes:
Accepted by the owner as a whole on 2026-10-26 (R0-15): every action,
decision and exclusion below is input of the later states.
### R0-19 — Open reads stay inside the host (owner, 2026-10-27)
### R0-20 — The owner changes the configuration, outside the API (owner, 2026-10-27)
judgement.why: The document says every decision below was accepted as part of the whole on 2026-10-26, while two decisions below are expressly dated as owner decisions on 2026-10-27.

topics.topic: Whether every decision requires V1 or legacy provenance
questions: Must each of these decisions be tied to a specific V1 or legacy finding, or should the status allow decisions that are new owner choices without such provenance?
Must each of these decisions be given a V1/legacy source, or is the universal provenance claim incorrect?

quotes:
Reverse-engineered from the
running Registry and its v1 specification (`SOURCE.md`): every decision below
names the v1 decision (V1-n) or the legacy finding (Ln) it keeps, narrows or
replaces.

### R0-20 — The owner changes the configuration, outside the API (owner, 2026-10-27)

Service tokens, the staff credential, the artifact vocabulary (R0-08) and the
frontend origin are the instance's configuration. The owner, as the host's
administrator, changes it outside Registry; a change takes effect when the
instance restarts, and a replaced token stops working at that restart, with no
overlap. Registry has no action that reads or changes its configuration.
judgement.why: The universal provenance claim says every decision names a V1-n or Ln source, but R0-20 is a decision whose passage names neither.

topics.topic: Browser access to Registry across the network boundary
questions: How does a frontend running in a user's browser reach Registry without making Registry reachable beyond its host?

topics.topic: Registry storage boundary for customer contact data
questions: Does the storage boundary include Registry-owned customer contact data, or must Registry truly store only project identity and artifact pointers?

topics.topic: Scope and behavior of the secret non-disclosure guarantee
questions: What exact inputs and outputs are covered by the secret non-disclosure promise, and what must happen when ordinary submitted data equals or contains a configured secret?
